annotations.title: Image metadata, EXIF: camera, date, GPS and size

description: Read an image's metadata from its URL: format (JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP), width and height, and for JPEG photos the EXIF data: camera make and model, lens, date taken, exposure, aperture, ISO, focal length, orientation, software and the GPS position (latitude, longitude, altitude) when it was recorded. Up to 15 MB. Use to check where and when a photo was taken, verify an upload, or strip-check images before publishing. Example: url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ianare/exif-samples/master/jpg/gps/DSCN0010.jpg. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
